title: B4/D5: John's desktop and workshop UAT tick list
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/UAT-JOHN-DESKTOP-WORKSHOP.md: 18 plain click/expected-result rows, per-device identification, Pass/Fail/Not run boxes and John’s signature. Separates office and workshop tasks, uses trial-only actions in a protected practice copy, and keeps actual device/runtime completion blank.

Source checked against corrected CN, D4 guides, time day-sheet buttons and workshop-my-jobs browser spec. In particular My jobs navigation opens the Job Board; it does not start a timer. No live sends, real staff hours, external AI or duplicate work instructed. Source/count review only; no runtime tests claimed or added for documentation. Exact head ae5564652c09af54d09f0b67baed3f9211cf5546. Original sign-off sheets and implementation owners untouched. No main merge, production SQL, Ready label or new feature.
